review.reason: Reviewed the v0.19.2 Bucket List linked-task photo preview: a small lazy/read-only UI using existing useTaskImage, viewport gating, and already bundled PhotoSwipe, with no change in entry/startup/Home budgets or Appwrite storage. Same-SHA GIPHY-enabled Vercel build exceeded only app raw and precache limits by 639/646 bytes (0.03%). Raise only those two ceilings by ~2 kB each, keeping a narrow bounded build variance allowance; do not change pinned baseline or disable the guard. Existing v0.19.0 budget review stays documented in PR #631.
